newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Post says to pilot insurance in post shops.
newsitem.headline: NZ Post says to pilot insurance in post shops.

text.p: New Zealand Post said on Monday it was to start a three month pilot selling insurance services through its Post Shop retail network from May 5.
The services will be marketed under the New Zealand Post Easy Cover brand and will be underwritten by State Insurance.
NZ Post said the pilot would involve 30 Post Shops. Depending on its outcome, the services may then be available at all 297 Post Shops nationwide, including Post Shop franchises.
NZ Post said the services were being piloted in response to strong growth in financial transactions at Post Shops and the recent introduction of deposit services by AMP's investment arm, Ergo.
State Insurance chief executive John Pritchard said the agreement with New Zealand Post offered a "tremendous opportunity" to extend State's physical sales presence.

"State's significant market share, particularly in motor vehicle and home and contents insurance, means developing new ways of reaching potential customers is a particularly important part of our growth plans," he said.
